_comment: Known-malicious package versions and container image digests that no build, lockfile, Dockerfile, compose file, Helm values file or CI workflow in this repo may reference.

Enforced by tests/test_known_malicious_packages.py (run: pytest tests/ -m 'not integration'). To respond to a new supply-chain incident, add the bad versions/digests here and cite the advisory in 'incidents'.
Any image under an 'images' repository, and any mirror of it, must also be referenced by digest (never by a mutable tag): the attacker can repoint tags.

incidents.summary: LiteLLM supply-chain compromise: credential-stealing litellm 1.107.0 on PyPI (2026-10-21 11:39-13:20 UTC) and malicious BerriAI images pushed as v1.107.0, latest, main-latest and main-stable (removed ~13:53 UTC).
